summary: Skill governs deterministic implementation-acceptance evidence for one explicit execution-plan target; no target-code implementation, approval, commit, release, or deployment; resolve candidate custody and explicit frozen baseline, never infer revisions or scope; require complete manifests, typed run request, action DAG, command registry, implementation contract or current compact prerequisite bundle, and Quick Dev receipt; build Acceptance knowledge context only through canonical Locator with hash/read-set validation; create typed Skill-input receipt through launcher and require ready validation; persist binding-derived append-only runs, preserve stale/legacy artifacts, rebuild successors on drift; execute registered deterministic evidence actions and finalize only with replayable current receipts; deterministic_only bypasses Bootstrap, semantic routes require repository-owned lineage projection and typed route; Bootstrap launch is external, high-cost acknowledgement required, later reentry needs trigger, recommendation, confidence, and user confirmation; enforce repair completeness, focused verification rules, three-round budget, and manual-pause closure protocol; exact reuse requires finalized v3 clean envelope, current bindings, eligible route, and lineage predecessor; P2 findings close deterministically; maintenance mode is single-maintainer with severity shifts for concurrency/injection; model routing is no-launch except policy-defined recovery; review scope must minimally cover seven implementation-conformance classes; unsupported pure Godot inputs; controlled_validation permits only typed shell-free commands in isolated roots.
